correctness.rationale: The signed matching sum splits by sizes zero through three. Inclusion–exclusion across three row choices produces (1+S1)(1+S2)(1+S3)−(1+S1)C23−(1+S2)C13−(1+S3)C12+2T. Counting matchings yields n^3+2n+1 ≡n+1 mod2, forbidding any zero at even n and requiring even magnitudes at odd n. The explicit H4 block has net C13 shift −4 and W shift 4(1+S2), preserving zero and −2 witnesses when S2=−1; H8 all sign triples has every nontrivial moment zero, preserving ±1 base witnesses at even lengths 2,4,6,8. These constructions prove the all-n parity dichotomy and sharp positive gaps, and Fourier eigenvalue reasoning gives inverse norms. Independent exact full Walsh enumerations n1..6 agree (zero counts 3,0,72,0,2730,0; gaps 2,1,2,1,2,1), not used as infinite proof.
